name: the Forbidden Woods
title: 🌲 The Forbidden Woods
blurb: Dense, tangled, and technically off the school grounds - which is exactly why half the school has been out here at least once. Not everything that lives out here is glad you came.

areas.at: at the gnarled edge of the treeline
in a clearing choked with low mist
beside an old, half-collapsed hunting blind
along a stream that's frozen despite the season
among a ring of standing stones
beside a hollow log big enough to crawl into
pushing through a deep thicket of brambles
at a cairn of old, mossy stones
along a trail of tracks too large to be a fox
at a black, still pond that reflects too many stars

atmospheres.text: The trees here grow close enough to block out most of the sky.
Something rustles in the brambles and then goes still, deliberately.
The quiet out here has a different quality than the quiet at school.
A cold mist clings to the ground, no higher than your knees.
Somewhere far off, something that might be a bird calls twice and stops.
Moonlight makes it down through the branches in thin, uneven strips.
The wind moves the leaves in a pattern that isn't quite the wind.
For a moment, everything - insects, wind, birds - goes completely silent.

creatures.a: a fox with, unmistakably, too many tails
a thicket of brambles that seems to lean in as you pass
a raven repeating the last thing you said, badly
a ring of glowing fungus, pulsing very slightly
something wolf-shaped, watching from just beyond the treeline

objects.a: bark carved with symbols you don't recognize
an old snare, long since rusted and empty
a standing stone, cracked clean down the middle
a puddle frozen despite the mild weather
an old lantern, unlit, hanging from a low branch

discoveries.text: a perfect ring of dark mushrooms nobody planted
claw marks on a tree trunk, high enough that you have to look up to find the top of them
a small cairn of stones that definitely wasn't there last time
a raven feather stuck upright in the ground like it was placed there
a patch of blackened acorns that never sprouted, arranged in a neat line
footprints that stop, mid-stride, and simply don't continue
a knot of roots tied deliberately, like a charm someone hung and forgot

outcomes.text: The path ahead seems to clear itself, just slightly, for you.
The mist parts and, for a moment, the whole clearing feels almost welcoming.
Nothing troubles you tonight. The woods, for once, feel like just woods.
A branch bends out of your way as you pass, like it meant to.
Something watches from the treeline. It doesn't follow. This time.
The brambles snag at your sleeve, once, hard, and then let go.
The trees seem to close in a little tighter around the path behind you.
You leave faster than you meant to. Something out there noticed you leaving.
The cold deepens the moment you stop walking.
Every sound in the woods pauses, all at once, like it's listening to you instead.

forage_lines: Half-buried in leaf litter {loc}, you find {item}.
You dig through the underbrush {loc} and come away with {item}.
forage_empty: You search {loc} and find nothing but cold dirt and dead leaves.
{Loc}, whatever was here has already been carried off.
You come away from {loc} empty-handed, glad to head back toward the lights of the castle.

feed_good: {The} takes it cautiously, then seems to relax, and leaves something behind.
feed_meh: {The} sniffs the offering and simply walks off with it, unimpressed.
follow_good: You follow {the} deeper than you meant to go, and it shows you something worth the risk.
{The} leads you somewhere you've never been - and then, quite suddenly, vanishes.
follow_lost: You follow {the} until you realize you've lost the path entirely. You find your own way back, eventually.
steal_good: You take it and back away slowly. {The} doesn't react. Somehow that's worse.
steal_caught: {The} reacts immediately, and not kindly. You leave with a fright and nothing else.
leave: You leave {the} well alone and head back toward the lights of the castle.
You decide some things in these woods aren't yours to disturb.
tend: You clear a little space around the ring and leave it be, tidier than before.
uproot: You tear it out of the ground. The woods go very quiet around you.

offer_lines.full: Whatever's out here has had enough offerings for one night. Your gift sits there, untouched.
warm: Your offering disappears from where you left it, quick and quiet.
The woods feel, if only slightly, less watchful as you leave.
cold: Your offering just sits there in the mist. Nothing comes for it.
The dark takes it without any sign it noticed you at all.
